definition: ἄ-θεος, -ον,  __1. in cl. __(a) slighting or denyiyig the gods (Plat.; cf. MM, VGT, see word);  __(b) godless, ungodly (Pind.);  __(with) abandoned by the gods (Soph.)  __2. In the NT (cf. Lft. on Ign. ad Trail, §3), of the heathen, without God, not knowing God (Cremer, 281): Eph.2:12.  † (AS)
